findings.summary: Added-version badges have insufficient text contrast in the light theme.
findings.fix: Use a darker teal foreground or lighter badge background that reaches at least 4.5:1 for the 14.4px badge text; verify all badge variants in both themes.
findings.evidence: Production manage-pages, reports, content-checks and account-settings: foreground #007d7e on #e0eff0 = 4.19:1; text is 14.4px. axe-core 4.11.1 confirms the failure.

findings.summary: Links inside light-theme note and warning panels fail the 4.5:1 text contrast requirement.
findings.fix: Give alert-content links a darker foreground that reaches 4.5:1 against both #e0eff0 and #e6e3f1, while retaining an underline and distinct hover/focus states.
findings.evidence: Production manage-users-and-roles and promote-search-results: #007d7e on #e0eff0 = 4.19:1. manage-snippets warning link: #007d7e on #e6e3f1 = 3.92:1. Text is 18px normal, requiring 4.5:1.

findings.summary: The theme switch becomes visually indistinguishable from its background in forced-colors mode.
findings.fix: Add a forced-colors style using system colors and a visible border or system-color icon so the switch and its state remain discernible; retain native color adjustment where possible.
findings.evidence: Chromium forcedColors: active on production homepage: switch background, ::before and ::after all rgb(255,255,255), border 0px none; no visible switch boundary or thumb remains.

passed: Representative homepage, section, overview, manage-pages and 404 layouts fit 320 CSS px without horizontal scrolling.

WCAG text-spacing override (line height 1.5, letter spacing .12em, word spacing .16em, paragraph spacing 2em) on homepage, overview, manage-pages and reference layouts caused no main-content overflow.
200% text resize through root font-size enlargement on homepage, overview and manage-pages retained content without horizontal scrolling or clipped visible text.
Theme toggle and sampled standalone controls meet 24 CSS px target size; short inline content links use the inline-text exception.
Main body, shared navigation, footer and native search input retain readable foreground/background combinations in sampled light and dark states.
Global 2px focus outline overrides theme-toggle outline removal via !important.
notes: No screenshots were taken. Runtime evidence is saved in raw/visual-runtime.json, raw/visual-extra.json and raw/visual-zoom-search.json.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce leaves the theme-switch .25s transition active. This is an enhancement opportunity, not an asserted WCAG AA failure for this brief user-triggered transition.
200% resize was tested with doubled root text size, not manual browser zoom.
Search input was inspected in both themes; autocomplete result styling should be corroborated by the dedicated search interaction audit.
